resources.string: No shuttles yet. Setting them up on the phone comes in a later version.
shuttle is watching your real-time shuttles. Tap to open.
shuttle was force-stopped, so nothing synced until you opened it. Syncing has started again.
shuttle needs three permissions to sync. You can give them now or later; until you do, the shuttles that need one wait and say which.
To read and write the folders you sync in the phone\'s storage. Without it, shuttles with a folder there wait, and nothing in them is synced or deleted.
To reach your NAS or other computers on your network. Without it, Android lets those connections time out, and shuttles with a share there wait.
To tell you about errors, conflicts and finished syncs, and to show while syncing runs. Without them, shuttle still syncs, silently.
